name: VendedorAI Sales Chat Widget
author: webmas2016

sections.description:
VendedorAI installs an AI-powered sales agent on your WordPress site in minutes. Your agent answers customer questions, captures leads automatically, and never sleeps.

How it works:

  1. Create a free account at app.vendedorai.com
  2. Train your agent by uploading PDFs or indexing your website URL
  3. Copy your Company ID from the My Snippet section
  4. Paste it in the plugin settings and save
  5. The widget appears automatically on your site

Key features:

  • 24/7 automatic customer support
  • Automatic lead capture with contact details
  • Learns from your PDF catalogs and website content
  • Fully customizable widget (colors, position, welcome message)
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • WooCommerce compatible — show only on product pages
  • Lightweight — adds less than 200ms to page load
  • GDPR friendly — no tracking, no cookies

Available plans:

  • Free — 100 messages/month, forever free, no credit card required
  • Starter — $14.99/month — 2,000 messages/month
  • Professional — $49.99/month — 10,000 messages/month
  • Business — $89.99/month — 20,000 messages/month

All paid plans include a 15% discount when billed annually.

Privacy Policy

VendedorAI sends conversation data to the VendedorAI API (api.vendedorai.com) to generate AI responses. No personal data is stored on your WordPress server. For more information, visit vendedorai.com/privacy.

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the VendedorAI service (vendedorai.com) to:

  • Load the chat widget (vendedorai.com/widget.js)
  • Process customer conversations via the VendedorAI API

By using this plugin, you agree to the VendedorAI Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “VendedorAI”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to VendedorAI > Settings and enter your Company ID

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and activate
  4. Go to VendedorAI > Settings and enter your Company ID

Getting your Company ID

  1. Create a free account at app.vendedorai.com
  2. Go to My Snippet in the sidebar
  3. Copy your Company ID (UUID format)
  4. Paste it in the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Do I need to create an account?

Yes, a free account at app.vendedorai.com is required. The free plan includes 100 messages per month with no credit card required.

Does the widget slow down my website?

No. The widget script loads asynchronously (defer) and adds less than 200ms to page load, which is imperceptible to users.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. You can configure the widget to appear only on product pages or shop pages.

How does the agent learn about my business?

Upload your PDF catalogs, price lists, or manuals in the VendedorAI dashboard. You can also index your website URL and the agent will learn from your existing content.

What happens when messages run out?

The widget shows a friendly message to visitors. Your message count resets automatically every month.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin itself does not store any personal data on your WordPress server. All conversation data is processed through the VendedorAI API. Please review the VendedorAI Privacy Policy for details.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes. From your VendedorAI dashboard you can customize colors, position, welcome message, agent name, and avatar.

What languages does the AI support?

The AI agent responds in the same language the customer uses. It works well in Spanish, English, Portuguese, and other major languages.
